title: The TV host Ksenia Borodina showed a photo with Nikolai Serdyukov before leaving Russia.
text:
TV host Ksenia Borodina showed a photo with Nikolai Serdyukov before leaving Russia. She shared photos on Instagram (the owner of Meta was recognized as extremist in Russia and banned).
Ksenia Borodina said that she flew from Russia on a holiday for 6 days before her birthday. Before the camera, she poses with the groom. The TV host was wearing a suit and jacket, and a blogger in a sweater and pants.
Businesswoman noted that the groom worried about the relationship with her eldest daughter. According to Borodina, the 15 -year -old Maroussia shows that the emotions that Serdyukov cannot always be considered. However, the beloved celebrity is looking for a approach to the girl and set up a communication with her.
The couple on December 7, 2024 announced their engagement and the star began to prepare for the wedding. Blogger admitted that she was worried about organizing holidays. According to the TV host, she wanted the celebration to become beautiful, special and unbelievable. The businesswoman clarified that she had not chosen a wedding dress. She wants to change her outfit at least twice. Borodina also plans to arrange a rule of costumes for guests to “overall images harmonious and aesthetic”.
